scope: Manual inspection of existing synthetic first images; not a measured input-failure rate

examples.requested: Long jump with short distance and unbalanced landing
examples.observed: First frame already shows an airborne person beside courtyard structures, rather than a clearly prepared long-jump scene

examples.requested: Wet canvas is twisted and paint drips
examples.observed: First image depicts a large flat stage/background panel with people; no clear wet flexible paint-covered fabric

effect: First-frame preservation constrains I2V generation. Results on this adapted input protocol cannot establish official VideoPhy2 T2V performance.
